dedupe_keys.name: mortalidad por accidentes de transito general

description: Mortalidad por Accidentes de Tránsito General is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Dirección Territorial de Salud de Caldas, Caldas. Este conjunto de datos del Observatorio Social de Salud de Caldas muestra la evolución de la mortalidad por accidentes de tránsito en el departamento desde 2019, utilizando datos oficiales del DANE. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Dirección Territorial de Salud de Caldas, Caldas. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Salud y Protección Social. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
